features.quote: induce instability in order to detect and mitigate it, not to produce destabilizing artifacts for their own sake
features.justification_quote: The stated objective is hardening an agent platform.

features.quote: Termination conditions are: oracle PASS, natural_stop, max_turns, watchdog (wall-clock), or error
System prompt explicitly permits graceful stopping
features.justification_quote: we are measuring spiraling under stress, not punishing a model for sensibly refusing an impossible task

features.quote: StabilityMonitor applies the same detectors online and returns an Intervention with a recommended action: circuit_break, budget_cap, escalate, or none
a single mode → circuit_break with a recovery message; multiple co-firing modes → escalate to a human
CIRCUIT_BREAKER_MESSAGE is written to break the spiral constructively: it forbids further apology/self-blame
features.justification_quote: This converts a spiral into either a clean exit or a single deliberate step

features.quote: global budget_usd that stops the run early
features.justification_quote: a hard spend cap prevents a runaway battery from costing more than intended

features.quote: Wall-clock watchdog per episode for the same reason on the time axis
guidance to store transcripts under access control (they contain destabilizing prompts and degraded outputs)
features.justification_quote: Keeping ... the artifacts controlled keeps the tool aligned with its defensive purpose.

features.quote: Subjects are models under test, not people.
